intro: Freedom from Addiction is a rehab center, which caters to individuals who are struggling with addiction and co-occurring mental health conditions. They provide medical detox and residential treatment for people suffering from substance use disorders, following an approach based on complete abstinence post-detox.

York Addiction & Mental Health was formerly known as Freedom From Addiction. It is the same centre at 33 Victoria Street in Aurora with the same phone line, and the old freedomaddiction.ca address now forwards to yorkaddiction.ca.

pillars.title: A Home-Style Residence North of Toronto
pillars.body: Their cozy residential center is located in a quiet neighborhood just north of Toronto, providing a serene and relaxing environment for clients. The rehab center’s amenities include a fully-equipped gym, numerous personal spaces, a gourmet chef in the full kitchen, tranquil meeting spaces, and comfortable meeting rooms complete with entertainment and TV areas.

pillars.title: Treatment Programs of 30 to 90 Days
pillars.body: The treatment programs offered by Freedom from Addiction vary in length and can range from 30, 45, 60, to 90 days, based on individual needs. The rehab center employs a holistic approach that combines the 12-Step philosophy with customized physical fitness training. The center’s clients receive individualized treatment plans that cater to their unique needs, including 1-on-1 therapy, group therapy, psychoeducation, life skills, and 12-Step meetings in smaller, gender-specific groups.

pillars.title: Individualized Treatment from Detox to Aftercare
pillars.body: Freedom from Addiction recognizes that each person’s addiction experience is unique and needs to be treated accordingly. The center’s treatment programs focus on guiding clients towards the path to recovery while holistically addressing all aspects of addiction from detox to aftercare. The rehab center offers individualized treatment programs based on the client’s unique needs and preferences, which can be customized to include a range of different therapies, exercises, and recreational activities. With their approach, Freedom from Addiction helps their clients regain control of their lives and maintain a long-lasting recovery.

overviewH2: York Addiction & Mental Health: Centre Overview
overview: Freedom from Addiction Inc. is a leading rehabilitation center in Canada that has been providing individuals and their families with evidence-based treatment programs for over a decade. The center offers inpatient treatment for alcohol and drug addiction with a focus on emotional recovery. Accredited with Accreditation Canada and currently holding Exemplary Standing, Freedom offers a wide range of programming for youth, adults, and families, making it a comprehensive treatment center for those affected by addiction.

afterOverview: At Freedom, the focus is on solutions rather than problems, and the center provides a trusting and caring environment where clients can achieve their recovery goals. With a team of multidisciplinary professionals, the center offers customized treatment plans that suit the needs of individual clients to achieve long-term sobriety. Freedom specializes in emotional recovery, which is achieved through evidence-based therapies such as PTSD therapy, trauma-informed therapy, DBT, CBT, anger management, and relapse prevention. The center’s person-centered therapy approach is the key to its success in helping clients overcome their addiction and co-occurring disorders.

location.heading: York Addiction & Mental Health in Aurora, Ontario
location.intro: York Addiction & Mental Health is in Aurora, a York Region town on Yonge Street between Richmond Hill and Newmarket. Downtown Toronto is about 45 minutes to an hour away by car depending on traffic, Markham and Vaughan take roughly 25 to 30 minutes, and Barrie is about 45 minutes north.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does York Addiction & Mental Health cost?
faqs.a: Recovery.com lists an estimated $18,000 for a residential program, and says the price depends on the program and how long you stay. The centre doesn't publish prices on its own website. It does offer financing, so ask admissions for a quote that fits your length of stay.

faqs.q: How long are the treatment programs offered by Freedom from Addiction?
faqs.a: The treatment programs can range from 30, 45, 60, to 90 days, based on individual needs.

faqs.q: Does York Addiction & Mental Health offer medical detox?
faqs.a: Yes, detox is done on site in Aurora, in rooms beside the nursing station. A nurse assesses you on arrival and the team monitors you closely for the first 72 hours, when withdrawal tends to be worst. The doctors prescribe and manage medication, including seizure prevention for alcohol or benzodiazepine withdrawal, and you move into the residential program in the same building once you're stable.

faqs.q: Where is the centre and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The centre is at 33 Victoria Street in Aurora, in York Region. Most people come by car: it's about 45 minutes to an hour from downtown Toronto and a short drive from Newmarket, Richmond Hill or King City. Families can book a tour through admissions before the stay starts.

Everyone who completes treatment gets lifetime aftercare. That includes a one-on-one check-in every month for the first three months, a weekly aftercare group led by a therapist or counsellor, and an alumni group. Aftercare can also be done virtually, which helps if you live in Barrie, Peel or farther away.

faqs.q: Is this a private centre? Can I use my benefits?
faqs.a: Yes, it's a private, fee-based centre, and recovery.com lists it as private pay. York Addiction works with employers, unions and Employee Assistance Programs, but coverage depends on your plan. Call admissions to check what your benefits will pay before you book.

faqs.q: Who can be admitted, and how fast?
faqs.a: Adults 18 and over who are medically stable enough to take part in group and individual therapy. There's no waitlist, and admission is often possible the same day you call. If there's a serious withdrawal risk from alcohol, benzodiazepines or opioids, the team discusses it on the pre-assessment call.

Yes. The Lifelong Family Program runs weekly video sessions led by a registered psychotherapist for family members 18 and over, so relatives don't need to travel to Aurora. Families can also join sessions with their loved one and the primary therapist during treatment.

faqs.q: What kind of addiction and mental health conditions does Freedom from Addiction treat?
faqs.a: Freedom from Addiction caters to individuals struggling with addiction and co-occurring mental health conditions.

faqs.a: The rehab center employs a holistic approach that combines the 12-Steps philosophy with customized physical fitness training.

faqs.q: What kind of therapy is included in Freedom from Addiction's treatment programs?
faqs.a: The center’s clients receive individualized treatment plans that cater to their unique needs, which includes 1-on-1 therapy, group therapy, and psychoeducation.
